correctness.rationale: The metric of T_a/(±1) gives min(delta(x-y),delta(x+y)). The map (x,y)→(x-y,x+y) is onto on the connected torus because multiplication by two is surjective; it sends product Haar to product Haar, so the two origin-distance variables are independent. This proves F=1-(1-H)^2. Substitution |x_i|=exp(u_i), s_i=log(a_i/2), makes H times fixed volume a marginal of the jointly log-concave e^{Σu_i} indicator of convex constraints u_i≤s_i and Σexp(2u_i)≤r²; Prékopa and permutation symmetry yield Schur concavity in log-side lengths. Strict Karamata for Σa_i² implies different circumradii, ensuring strict stochastic dominance somewhere; ball containment and corner simplex scaling give short- and far-tail formulas. Direct independent circular-segment formulas and grid evaluations of four planar shape ratios corroborated the CDF; proofs are all-dimensional analytic, not simulation.
